label.purpose: Datelines, sample tags, tabular chart/table labels.

shadows.name: button-press

motion.name: ease-out-expo

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one crimson call-to-action, used for every sign-up/start action across the page.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #a3392a; color: #f3e9d2; border: 1px solid #832a1e; padding: 0.85rem 1.6rem; border-radius: 6px; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.9375rem; box-shadow: 0 2px 0 #832a1e; transition: transform 240ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), box-shadow 240ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), background-color 240ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #bb4736; transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 6px 0 #832a1e; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(0); box-shadow: 0 1px 0 #832a1e; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #f0c874; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Low-emphasis header action ("Sign in"); transparent with a gold-tinted border.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: #f3e9d2; border: 1px solid rgba(216,155,60,0.45); padding: 0.85rem 1.6rem; border-radius: 6px; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.9375rem; transition: background-color 240ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: rgba(216,155,60,0.12); }

components.name: Sample Tag
components.description: Truth-labeling pill that marks every piece of illustrative/demo data (weekly yield, seasonal chart) as synthetic.
components.css: .ds-tag-sample { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; white-space: nowrap; font-family: 'Space Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.6875rem; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #f0c874; border: 1px solid rgba(216,155,60,0.55); border-radius: 999px; padding: 0.2rem 0.65rem; }

components.name: Ledger Paper Card
components.description: The lamplit ledger-paper sheet every table, chart, and demo panel sits on. Never the page's own background.
components.css: .ds-paper { background-color: #f2e4c6; background-image: radial-gradient(ellipse 140% 90% at 30% 0%, rgba(255,255,255,0.25), transparent 60%); color: #2a1d14; border-radius: 6px; padding: 3.25rem; box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.4) inset, 0 22px 40px -18px rgba(12,7,4,0.65); }

components.name: Wax Seal
components.description: Signature stamp component. Plays a one-time 'stamp down' animation on successful sign-up — the page's single most distinctive motion moment.
components.html: <svg class="ds-seal" width="96" height="96" viewBox="0 0 96 96" fill="none"><circle cx="48" cy="48" r="42" fill="#a3392a" stroke="#832a1e" stroke-width="2"/><circle cx="48" cy="48" r="42" fill="none" stroke="#d6685a" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="2 4" opacity="0.6"/><path d="M48 27c4.5 4 7 8.6 7 12.8a7 7 0 1 1-14 0c0-4.2 2.5-8.8 7-12.8Z" fill="#f2e4c6" opacity="0.92"/><path d="M48 40.5v22" stroke="#f2e4c6" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.92"/><path d="M40 55h16" stroke="#f2e4c6" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.92"/></svg>
components.css: .ds-seal { filter: drop-shadow(0 10px 18px rgba(24,15,9,0.45)); } .ds-seal.stamped { animation: ds-stamp-down 640ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } @keyframes ds-stamp-down { 0% { transform: translateY(-26px) scale(1.3) rotate(-8deg); opacity: 0; } 55% { transform: translateY(2px) scale(0.97) rotate(2deg); opacity: 1; } 75% { transform: translateY(-1px) scale(1.02) rotate(-1deg); } 100% { transform: translateY(0) scale(1) rotate(0deg); } }

components.name: Ledger Table
components.description: Borderless table where each cell carries its own dashed underline sized to its own content width, like a receipt line. Row headers (th[scope=row]) always render as Fraunces entry titles — this lives in the shared primitive so exam/category titles never accidentally inherit the column-header mono styling.

components.css: .ds-ledger-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-ledger-table th { text-align: left; font-family: 'Space Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.6875rem; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #6b5738; font-weight: 500; padding-block-end: 0.5rem; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(42,29,20,0.22); } .ds-ledger-table td, .ds-ledger-table th[scope='row'] { padding-block: 0.75rem; border-bottom: 1px dashed rgba(42,29,20,0.18); } .ds-ledger-table th[scope='row'] { font-family: 'Fraunces', serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.0625rem; text-transform: none; letter-spacing: normal; color: #2a1d14; }

components.name: Stat Tile
components.description: Operate-mode dashboard primitive: a panel holding one icon/number/label triple (seeds, nutrients, trees, average score). Three to four per row, collapsing to two columns under 640px.
components.html: 7seeds in your garden
components.css: .ds-stat-tile { background-color: #f2e4c6; border-radius: 6px; padding: 2rem; box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.4) inset, 0 22px 40px -18px rgba(12,7,4,0.65); display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.2rem; } .ds-stat-tile__value { font-family: 'Fraunces', serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.75rem; color: #2a1d14; } .ds-stat-tile__label { font-size: 0.8125rem; color: #6b5738; }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: Difficulty (beginner/intermediate/advanced) and tree-phase (seed/growing/mature/fall) pills. Same markup, two color contexts per The Paper Context Rule: light text on the dark ground, dark text inside a .panel.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; padding: 0.2rem 0.55rem; border-radius: 999px; white-space: nowrap; background: rgba(70,97,47,0.2); color: #7c9a5e; } .panel .ds-badge--beginner { color: #334a21; }

components.name: Dashboard Sidebar Nav
components.description: Vertical nav list (Overview/Categories/Exams/Garden/Progress). Active item gets a crimson-tinted background fill, never a border-left accent. Below 860px the whole sidebar collapses to brand+hamburger, reusing the marketing header's morph-to-X toggle to reveal nav + user info + logout inline.
components.css: .ds-nav-item { display: block; padding: 0.55rem 0.85rem; border-radius: 6px; color: #c9b08a; text-decoration: none; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: rgba(216,155,60,0.1); color: #faf3e2; } .ds-nav-item[aria-current='page'] { background: rgba(163,57,42,0.18); color: #faf3e2; }

narrative.overview: Flashmemo's landing page is staged as a study desk after dark: a warm, soil-brown ground lit by one lamp, with sheets of ledger paper pinned onto it wherever the product needs to show real information. The world was arrived at through Impeccable's direction-roll process (seed key c5f7050f), landing on an almanac/harvest-ledger reading of the product's existing reward mechanism — seeds, trees, and a garden — rather than the generic warm-cream-plus-serif-plus-red-accent look that a from-scratch AI pass defaults to. The page deliberately inverts that default: the dominant field is dark, not pale cream, and paper only ever appears as a lamplit inset, never as the page's own ground. Every demonstrative number on the page is synthetic and explicitly tagged Sample ledger / Sample season — a real, load-bearing rule, since the product has no hosted instance yet.
keyCharacteristics: Dark, warm soil-brown ground; ledger paper exists only as a lit inset, never as the page background.
One saturated accent (oxblood crimson) reserved for action and the wax-seal signature moment; harvest gold carries identity and headlines; garden green is used sparingly for the reward motif.
Mixed type system: warm display serif for headlines, monospace for ledger figures/labels, humanist sans for body copy.
Structure borrows almanac/ledger conventions (dotted leaders, dashed rules, tabular entries, seasonal brackets) instead of icon-plus-heading card grids.
Motion is restrained to two authored moments: the harvest-chart bars growing in, and a wax seal stamping down on successful sign-up.

rules.name: The Paper-Never-Is-The-Page Rule
rules.body: Ledger paper is only ever a card, table, or chart surface pinned onto the dark ground — it never becomes the page's own background.

rules.name: The One Red Rule
rules.body: Crimson is the only saturated color used for interactive action. Gold and forest never carry a clickable affordance.

rules.name: The Paper Context Rule
rules.body: page-title, page-lede, field label, field-error, form-alert--error/--info, button--ghost, and every badge--* default to light tones for the dark ground; each has a .panel-scoped override that darkens it for the light ledger-paper ground instead. Reusing a dark-ground primitive inside a panel without its paper override produces text that is present but functionally invisible — a real contrast failure, learned building the dashboard.

rules.name: The No-Kicker Rule
rules.body: No section carries a small eyebrow label above its own heading; the almanac dateline appears once, at the very top of the page, as masthead convention rather than a marketing kicker.

rules.name: The Grain-Not-Gloss Rule
rules.body: Depth on paper surfaces comes from grain and a soft offset shadow, never a gradient overlay standing in for texture or a fake bevel/emboss filter.

dos: Do keep ledger paper as an inset surface only — cards, tables, chart sheets — never the page's own background.
Do tag every invented number or chart with a Sample ledger/Sample season pill until the product has a real hosted instance with real user data.
Do reserve crimson for action and the one signature seal moment; keep gold and forest out of clickable chrome.
Do texture every paper surface with the grain treatment — a flat solid fill reads as machine-made in this world.
Do default motion to visible-first: any scroll-triggered animation must render its content fully even if the trigger never fires.
Do give every interactive component all of default/hover/focus/active/disabled/loading/error states before shipping it.
Do reuse the marketing header's hamburger-to-X pattern for any new mobile nav rather than inventing a horizontal-scroll strip.
donts: Don't add a kicker/eyebrow label above any section heading.
Don't use icon-plus-heading-plus-text card grids for feature lists; use the ledger/table/entry vocabulary instead.
Don't fake physical relief (CSS bevel/emboss/stamped-metal filters) on the wax seal or paper cards.
Don't apply the same scroll-reveal fade to every section; the page's motion budget is the chart grow-in and the wax-seal stamp, not a uniform per-section entrance.
Don't place a dark-ground-tuned color primitive inside a .panel without checking it has a paper-context override.
